title: Loop-related mentions rose in ICLR 2027 submissions
onSlide: Loop-related mentions rose in ICLR 2027 submissions
Independent ICLR 2027 Trends analysis · OpenReview metadata snapshot: 26 Oct 2026 · shares recalculated from counts.
Title + abstract mentions of latent / looped / recurrent-depth reasoning
Keyword mentions, including latent reasoning—not a count of pure looped architectures.
Includes withdrawals and desk rejections. Submission does not imply acceptance.
notes:
독립 분석에서는 관련 표현이 등장한 투고가 48편에서 289편으로, 비중은 약 0.24%에서 0.67%로 늘었습니다. latent reasoning까지 포함한 제목·초록 검색입니다. 철회와 심사 전 탈락도 포함하므로 채택 논문 수와는 다릅니다.

[Sources and evidence limits — not spoken]
https://txie1.github.io/iclr2027-trends/
Keyword category: latent, looped & recurrent-depth reasoning. Pattern: latent reasoning|continuous (thought|reasoning)|looped (transformers?|language models?|models?)|recurrent[- ]depth
2026: 48 / 19814 = 0.24225295%; 2027: 289 / 42822 = 0.67488674%. The displayed 0.67% is rounded from counts, not from the source's already rounded 0.675%. notes:
